High-Touch Customer Success | Building the Future of Construction | Hybrid in Detroit

About RIVET

RIVET is how construction labor gets to work. RIVET’s software platform transforms the way contractors manage, plan, schedule, and deploy crews in one unified platform. The RIVET team is passionate about leveraging technology to champion the skilled trades, accelerate digital transformation, and make construction an industry of choice for a new generation entering the workforce.

The Role

As an Implementation Manager
at RIVET, you'll bring your construction experience—everything you've learned running jobs, coordinating labor, and leading crews—to customers turning to RIVET to solve their labor needs, getting them up and running on our platform. You own the post-sale experience, guiding new customers through the full onboarding journey from kickoff through training, adoption, and the switch away from the whiteboards, spreadsheets, and legacy tools they've always relied on. Your days look like leading training sessions with superintendents, project managers, and operations leaders, keeping implementations on schedule, clearing roadblocks, and being the trusted advisor who understands both how the software works and what it's actually like to run work in the field. You'll sit at the heart of our Customer Success team, reporting to the Manager, Customer Success, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with Account Management, Support, and Product & Engineering so every customer gets a foundation they can build on.

We're scaling fast, and we need someone who knows that getting a construction company to change how it works is hard-won, not handed over. This isn't a cookie-cutter, check-the-box rollout. You'll roll up your sleeves, have the candid conversations that field people respect, win over crews who've watched tech promises come and go, and still deliver an onboarding that sets each customer up to succeed long-term.

As you grow in this role, you'll help shape and refine our onboarding playbooks, mentor new team members, and take on more strategic work as our customer base and team expand. If you came up in the trades or construction operations and want to put that hard-earned credibility to work transforming an industry that tech has overlooked for too long, this role will only become more impactful over time.

What You'll Do

Lead end-to-end customer onboarding from kickoff through go-live, ensuring customers successfully transition from legacy solutions to the RIVET platform within defined timelines

Contribute to continuous process improvement by identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping iterate on onboarding workflows and best practices that can scale across the team

What You'll Bring

Hands-on construction experience–ideally as a project manager, labor coordinator, superintendent, foreman, or in a similar field or operations leadership role–that brings instant credibility with customers who value someone who has lived the day-to-day realities of running work in the field
Direct MEP trade experience (mechanical, electrical, plumbing, or sheet metal) is required as you'll be working with contractors who expect you to speak their language
At least 3 years of experience in either (a) customer success, account management, implementation, or enterprise project management for B2B SaaS products or (b) construction field and operations leadership, such as managing crews, coordinating labor, running projects and schedules, or training field staff. We weigh real construction operations experience heavily and will support the right field leader in making the jump into software
Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder relationships–whether mid-market or enterprise accounts, or large project teams with many moving parts and competing priorities
Strong project management instincts–whether from juggling concurrent implementations or running multiple jobs, schedules, and deliverables at once–with a track record of driving accountability to timelines

Skill in de-escalating tense situations and getting stalled work back on track
Outstanding communication skills across phone, email, and video—able to tailor messaging for both technical users and business decision-makers
Natural teacher ability, guiding people through adopting new tools and processes, especially in an industry that is resistant to change
Proven ability to diagnose needs, uncover blockers, and problem-solve collaboratively through active listening and consultative engagement
Comfort navigating disengagement, ghosting, or pushback with diplomacy, persistence, and creative problem-solving
Technical aptitude and comfort quickly learning new software platforms to become a product subject matter expert–no prior software-vendor experience required
Willingness to learn and consistently use a CRM (HubSpot preferred) to document interactions, track project status, and maintain data hygiene
Self-motivation and resourcefulness, with the ability to work autonomously, prioritize effectively, and seek out answers without constant direction
Ability to travel up to 25% for onsite customer trainings, kickoffs, or strategic meetings

Even Better

Bachelor's degree in business, technology, construction management, or a related field
Background in training design, instructional design, or enablement, especially creating scalable onboarding content or train-the-trainer programs
Experience working at a high-growth startup or early-stage company where processes are still being built and iteration is constant

Comfort with data analytics or interpreting customer performance metrics to identify trends, diagnose issues, or demonstrate ROI

Lead complex infrastructure, cloud, transformation, migration, managed services, and professional services projects from inception through closure.
Establish and manage project governance frameworks, delivery methodologies, reporting structures, and decision-making forums.
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, budgets, forecasts, RAID logs, dependencies, and resource plans.
Ensure successful delivery against scope, cost, quality, schedule, and business outcome objectives.
Manage project change control processes and ensure appropriate governance of scope and commercial variations.
Proactively identify, manage, and resolve project risks, issues, and dependencies.
Drive project teams to deliver customer outcomes whilst maintaining high standards of quality and customer satisfaction.
Ensure smooth transition of delivered services into Business-As-Usual operations.

Customer Leadership & Relationship Management

Act as the primary customer-facing delivery lead and trusted advisor throughout the engagement lifecycle.
Build and maintain strong relationships with customer executives, program sponsors, IT leadership, and business stakeholders.
Earn customer confidence through credibility, transparency, and consistent delivery excellence.
Handle customer escalations professionally and effectively, ensuring rapid resolution of issues.
Influence customer stakeholders and help align project outcomes to broader business objectives.
Create opportunities to strengthen customer relationships, improve customer satisfaction, and increase customer loyalty.
Recognise opportunities for additional services, project expansion, and future engagements, collaborating with account teams to support customer growth.
Represent the organisation professionally in all customer interactions, helping to position the company as a strategic partner rather than simply a delivery provider.

Executive Communication & Stakeholder Management

Provide regular executive-level updates to both customer and internal leadership teams.
Prepare and deliver project status reports, steering committee presentations, programme reviews, and governance packs.
Translate complex technical and delivery information into concise business-focused messages appropriate for executive audiences.
Present project health, financial performance, risks, mitigation strategies, and critical decisions with confidence and clarity.
Facilitate workshops, executive briefings, customer governance forums, and leadership reviews.
Influence stakeholders at all organisational levels, from engineers and project teams through to C-level executives.
Build credibility through exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills.

Financial & Commercial Management

Own project financial performance including revenue, margin, forecasting, profitability, utilisation, and cost management.
Ensure projects remain commercially viable and align with contractual obligations.
Manage Statements of Work, project budgets, financial forecasts, and change requests.
Support pre-sales engagements, proposal development, project estimation, and delivery planning activities.
Collaborate with Sales, Solutions Architects, and Delivery Leadership to develop customer-focused solutions.
Identify commercial risks and opportunities and escalate appropriately.

People Leadership

Lead cross-functional teams consisting of project managers, architects, consultants, engineers, operations teams, partners, and third-party suppliers.
Provide direction, mentoring, and coaching to junior project managers and coordinators.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence.
Resolve resource conflicts and effectively manage competing priorities.
Drive high-performing project teams through effective leadership and communication.
